main_text.head: MAXAE MYLIANI DE VRIENDT, SENATVI GANDAVENSI A SECRETIS, AD IVSTI LIPSI de Cruce libros, Epigramma.

p.i: SVpplicij ferale genus, trabs hospita leti, Crux olim, & dirus sontibus horror erat. Tormentum iniisum, durum, execrabile lignum, Quo grauius nullum terra nouerca dabat. At postquam sata patre Deo, sata Virgine proles Diluit in celsa crimina nostra cruce: Victima pro seruis dominus, pro sontibus insons, Pro laesis medicus, pro grege pastor amans; Ilicet ex illo, Crux lux, mors vita, trophaeum Furca, decus probrum, poena medela fuit. Hospite pressa Deo tanti Crux numinis, olim Crux scelerum Nemesis, nunc scelerum vna salus. Hoc olim tam grande decus, tam nobile pignus Terra diu caeco texit auara sinu: Dum veluti postliminio tandem extulit illam, Et luci lucem Caesar habere dedit.
Fallor? an & IVSTVS ceu Caesaris aemulus, atra Nocte laborantem tollit ad astra Crucem? O factum iuste: sic ridení lumina iustis, Inuidia iniustis lumina fracta dolent.

page.notes: Title lines set in spaced capitals and small capitals; the marginal note "*Constantinus" stands at the right beside "Et luci lucem". Lines in the first verse pair are partly illegible on the scan; "ridení" in the sixth line of the last stanza is read as printed "ridĕt" and is doubtful. "Anumam rex Delius indit." is the printed closing line, read with [?] where uncertain: Anumam[?] rex Delius indit[?]. Catchword "Q" reproduced as printed at lower right.
